description: Armature's gates (ADR 0011): a merge, gh pr merge or push into main must pass the gate, a commit on main may touch only rendered sections and candidate ledger entries, .armature/ holds the gate's own stamps, and a confirmation, acceptance or waiver asks the user. Each command is two lines. Git Bash (or sh) runs the first, which replaces it with scripts/armature.sh, and never reads the second. PowerShell, Claude Code's fallback where there is no Git Bash, fails the first harmlessly and runs the second, which reads scripts/armature.ps1 as text, since Windows' default execution policy refuses a script file.
